invitations.intro: This bot is self-hosted: it only accepts servers whose owner has been given an access code. Redeem yours here, then pick your server.

etapes.une: Ask the bot owner for an access code.
etapes.deux: Redeem it on this page, signed in with your Discord account.
etapes.trois: Add the bot to the server of your choice: it will stay there.

indisponible.texte: The bot cannot be reached to check a code right now. Try again in a few minutes.

ouvert.texte: This instance accepts every server: you can add the bot right away.
ouvert.bouton: Add the bot to my server

connexion.texte: A code is tied to your Discord account: that is how the bot recognises you when you add it to your server.

form.label: Your access code
form.aide: Case, spaces and dashes do not matter.

erreurs.unknown: No such code. Check what you typed, or ask for another one.
erreurs.revoked: This code was revoked by the bot owner.
erreurs.exhausted: This code has already been used for as many servers as allowed.
erreurs.offline: The bot did not answer. Try again in a moment.
erreurs.anonymous: Your session expired. Sign in again, then retry.
erreurs.too_soon: Your request is already in. Give them time to answer before sending another.
erreurs.not_needed: No code is needed here: you can add the bot right away.

succes.texte: Your code is held for {minutes} minutes. Add the bot now: it will stay on the server you choose.
succes.bouton: Add the bot to my server
succes.apres: Once the bot is in, your server shows up in the dashboard.

proprio.intro: You own this bot. This is where you decide who may add it.
proprio.indisponible: The bot is unreachable: codes cannot be listed right now.
proprio.echec: The bot refused or did not answer. Nothing was changed.

porte.exige: A code is required: a server added without one sees the bot leave straight away.
porte.libre: Open to everyone: anyone can add the bot. Codes no longer matter.
porte.note: Servers already in place are never re-examined: closing the door makes the bot leave nowhere.

site.label: This site's address
site.aide: Quoted by the bot in the note it leaves before quitting a server with no code. Empty: it says nothing about it.
site.invalide: Invalid address: it must start with http:// or https://.

creer.label: Nickname or name
creer.labelAide: Who this code is for. For your eyes only: never shown to whoever redeems it.
creer.securite: Nothing to make up: the bot draws the code at cryptographic random — twelve characters from an alphabet with no O/0 or I/1, so it can be read out without mistakes.

codes.confirmer: Delete this code? The servers it opened stay authorised.

serveurs.aide: Where the bot actually is, including servers it joined while the door was open. Making it leave takes effect at once, but nothing stops anyone from adding it back — blocking the server does.
serveurs.porteOuverte: Joined without a code, door open
serveurs.motifAide: Never shown to the server: the bot leaves without saying why. This is what you will read again the day you hesitate to reopen.
serveurs.confirmerQuitter: Make the bot leave this server? It leaves at once, and its authorisation is revoked.
serveurs.confirmerBloquer: Block this server? The bot will not come back — not with the door open, not with a code that is still valid.
serveurs.confirmerDebloquer: Unblock this server? It will be able to host the bot again.

demandes.mpEchoue: Direct message impossible — with no server in common, Discord refuses it. They will read the answer on the site.

demande.texte: Leave a note for the bot owner. They will get your request as a DM, with your Discord account so they can reply.
demande.label: Your message
demande.envoyee: Request sent. The owner will reply on Discord — keep your DMs open.
demande.envoyeeSansMp: Request saved. The owner did not get it as a DM, but it is waiting on their dashboard.

maDemande.attenteTexte: Sent on {date}. The bot owner will answer right here — come back to this page.
maDemande.reponseCode: Your access code is ready below: redeem it, then add the bot.
